title: Seok-Ju Hahn
text:
Seok-Ju Hahn


(Suck-Zoo)




my sign is scorpio



Hi, I’m Seok-Ju! I am currently a postdoc at Argonne National Laboratory.


My research is driven by a desire to improve real-world ML systems. Primary areas of interest include:



Algorithm Design:  {adaptive; generalization-aware; private}    optimization 


Networked Framework:  {federated; collaborative; decentralized}    machine learning 



In my free time, I sing 🎤 R&B and do kettlebell 🐮🔔 swings. I am open to new collaborations and opportunities. Let’s connect!
